report_name: LOCAL CYCLING AND WALKING INFRASTRUCTURE PLAN
how_pct_was_used: The Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT) was used as one of the key datasets to inform the development of network plans for cycling and walking.
other_tools_developed: Prioritisation scoring mechanism based on effectiveness, policy alignment, economic factors, and deliverability; DfT Route Selection Tool; DfT Walking Route Audit Tool (WRAT)
specific_evidence_of_impact: The LCWIP identified three priority corridors (Cobblers Hall to Newton Aycliffe Railway Station, Stephenson Way, and Town Centre to Aycliffe Business Park) for immediate feasibility assessment and development, and established a prioritised programme of infrastructure improvements to support future funding applications.
